messages:
maya_pm: brainstorming an 'auto-pin rollover' feature for catalog pins. idea: pins have TTL, and when TTL nears we run a controlled canary migration with tenant preview and optional credits. want to align on launch gates + defaults.

aj_dev: ok. ownership Q: who runs canary evals (research infra or product infra)? need tenant-level opt-out flag and API for pin metadata.

sasha_research: we should repurpose the existing onboard suite but provide a 'lite' runner for quick nightly canaries (bench: onboard-standard-lite). include embed-stability check + perf.

maya_pm: draft launch gates: (1) canary bench pass (onboard-standard-lite), (2) p99 latency delta <= 2%, (3) embed cosine drift <= 1%, (4) token-cost delta <= 10%. tenant must be notified and allowed opt-out. any missing?

lucas_support: add contractual guardrail: customers with explicit pin clauses are excluded by default. comm cadence: 30d/14d/7d notices + preview link. credits for opting into auto-roll.

aj_dev: sketch of pin metadata and rollout config: ```yaml
auto_pin_rollover:
  ttl_days: "90"
  canary_size_pct: "1"
  bench_suite: "onboard-standard-lite"
  warmup_prefixes: "tenant-generated"
  rollback_triggers: ["latency>2%","embed_drift>1%","cost>10%"]
```

tina_engineering: infra constraints: small canaries under-populate KV caches -> p99 noisy. recommend canary_size_pct >= 1% and synthetic prefix warmups to stabilise measurements. also need orchestration hooks for phased rollout across GPUs.

sasha_research: agree re: synthetic prefixes. will provide golden prompt set per tenant and metrics: exact-match rate, rerank drift, embed cosine mean/std. include a 'quality score' composite.

opsbot: canary-run scheduled: tenant_482 window start=1812350123 status=running (auto).

maya_pm: rollout schedule idea: when TTL hits 30d window, run nightly canary attempts over a 7d spread to avoid capacity spikes. if canary fails, notify SE and keep pin. if passes and tenant consented, background roll starts and tenant can still opt-out mid-roll.

aj_dev: API changes: GET/POST on /pins/{tenant}/{model} to include rollover config + recent canary results. Console: preview UI + 'run canary now' button for SEs. Epic to include metrics plumbing + rollout state machine.

sasha_research: i'll author the evaluation spec PR with threshold numbers and the exact metric formulas. will include a synthetic warmup protocol.

lucas_support: i'll draft the tenant email templates + opt-in credit tiers. include a clear rollback contact path.

maya_pm: checklist for go/no-go: bench spec merged, infra simulation of cache warming, support comms + legal opt-out filter, API + console mocks reviewed. target: sign-off next sprint.

aj_dev: follow-ups assigned: aj -> epic + API contract by EOW, tina -> infra design + cache-warmup plan, sasha -> bench PR, lucas -> comms + opt-out list. tagging @tina_engineering for immediate review. :thumbsup:
